text: Invited panelist, GeoAI Symposium panel on AI and disaster resilience, AAG Annual Meeting, New York (upcoming).
Lead convener and chair of a session at the AGU Annual Meeting, San Francisco.
Teaching ILS 250: Introduction to GIS and ILS 590: GIS Capstone at Purdue this fall.
Paper with undergraduate mentee Ethan Massey on spatiotemporal predictability of dengue presented at IGARSS 2026, Washington, D.C.
Joined Purdue University as Clinical Assistant Professor in the Department of Information Studies.
Invited talk at the UCGIS Cyber Training Workshop, College Park, MD, on AI-driven segmentation of LiDAR data in informal settlements.
Named a Featured Mentor of the MIT Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program.
Best Presentation Nomination Award at the 5th Digital Twin International Conference, Germany.
Our paper on AI-driven segmentation of LiDAR data in informal settlements is published in npj Urban Sustainability.
Received the Geospatial Excellence Award from the Geospatial Council of Australia and completed my Ph.D. at UNSW.
